'''Turn Bow''' is a female pack leader.

== Appearance ==
Turn Bow is aged.

== Activities ==
Steps informs [[Perrin Aybara]] in the [[wolf dream]], that Moonhunter ([[Lanfear]]) seeks him.

== Trivia ==
